hard_rules: A FRESH_REVIEW must cite the exact current asset_manifest_id+manifest_revision and the exact asset_id+asset_revision+fingerprint for every page in its dependency scope.
When any in-scope page fingerprint or asset_revision changes, this evidence automatically becomes STALE.
CARRY_FORWARD_BINDING does not change the old review. It is permitted only when every asset in this review's dependency scope is byte/version-identical between old and current manifests.
If the changed page is inside the review dependency scope, carry-forward is forbidden and the affected reviewer must run again.
R12 cross-page visual review normally depends on the whole visual set; any visual change is presumed in-scope unless the task explicitly proves otherwise.
IMAGE-QA barrier may report ALL PASS only when R10/R11/R12 each have one valid effective binding to the exact same current asset_manifest_id+manifest_revision.
r13_rule: R13 must cite the same manifest identity that completed IMAGE-QA and may not combine copy review with images from another manifest revision.
